# LinkedIn Profile Scraper

> Send a LinkedIn profile URL that already opens. You get the role, about, location, education, certifications, and activity in one row.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.80 per 1,000 profiles.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-details
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-details`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You already decided this profile is worth the full record.

## Use something else when

You only need the current company and headline. Use Profile Freshness Check at $0.40 per 1,000, then scrape the rows you choose. The URL does not open. Use Fix Broken LinkedIn URLs first.

## Page

- Scrape a LinkedIn profile from a URL you already have: docs/linkedin-profile-scraper-by-url.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
